question: If W is coded as 46 and CAT is coded as 48, then DOG will be coded as:
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a98eb53c610e1330a8af1b6e691977529e725be47799627c13ecb606fd10c7d9.png] 

**Sum of alphabet positional values × 2 = Number code.**

 
• W is coded as 46 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61feb45e2b7477e746e4c77ef8626583f686fa5d2bc003c61ab545a3831c0de2.png] 

= 23 × 2

= 46

And,

 
• CAT is coded as 48

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3b37a4899c6c62b9da671f50bc2d89246a185bb519fe842ffa87a34f4a3394f.png] 

= (3 + 1 + 20) × 2

= 24 × 2

= 48

Similarly,

 
• **DOG will be coded as:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3932c08750f45545ff3225bff3a1e8b03e30d37c932ee966c4a438498d450454.png] 

 

**= (4 + 15 + 7) × 2**

**= 26 × 2**

**= 52**

Hence, the correct answer is **"52".**
